headline: Student Leader Declares Hunger Strike Over, Cites 'Exhausting Need To Explain What A Calorie Is' To Supporters
body:
The prominent youth activist who had been on a widely publicised hunger strike for forty-eight hours abruptly broke his fast Thursday, citing an insurmountable fatigue caused by explaining basic biology to his enthusiastic, yet nutritionally illiterate, social media following. 

'I had people sliding into my DMs asking if my internal organs were technically on a sabbatical,' said the activist, who returned to a diet of dry toast and lukewarm chai. 'Every time I tried to discuss policy, someone would ask if my hunger strike counted towards their intermittent fasting goals. By the second day, I wasn't fighting for the cause anymore—I was fighting the urge to send a nutritional textbook to every user who asked if I was "fueling my protest with just pure ideology."'

His medical team confirmed that the decision to eat was purely strategic, noting that the activist’s blood sugar levels were fine, but his patience with public misconceptions about basic metabolic survival had hit a critical low. The protest, which began as a demand for administrative reform, concluded as the activist realized that maintaining the moral high ground is significantly harder when you are hallucinating that your desk chair is a plate of butter chicken.

Following the announcement, the student union clarified that they will be moving forward with a new, less caloric form of protest: a 'prolonged stare-down' at the administrative building, which involves no fasting but requires participants to maintain intense, awkward eye contact with security guards until someone leaves the premises out of sheer discomfort.
caption: Not all heroes wear capes, but some of them definitely need a sandwich before they lose their minds. A masterclass in knowing when to pivot from idealism to dal-chawal. (satire) #studentpolitics #hungerstrike #realism
